opennyai_summary.final__decision:
By this petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioner, namely, Jahidul Islam has prayed for granting pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Manikpur P.S. Case No. 27/2023 u/s 376(3) of the IPC r/w Section 9/10/11 (1) of the Page No.# 2/2 Prohibition of Child Marriage Act Jahidul Islam vs The State Of Assam on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92689733/
1 r/w Section 6/17 of the POCSO Act .
In view of above, the interim pre-arrest bail granted vide order, dated 21.02.2023 is hereby made absolute, subject to the following conditions- (i) That the petitioner shall co-operate in investigation as and when required;
(ii) That the petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and (iii) That the petitioner shall not hamper or tamper with the investigation in any manner.
This disposes off the anticipatory bail application.
